anchors.paper_title: Whole-brain electrophysiological functional connectivity dynamics in resting-state EEG
anchors.reason: Shou, Yuan et al. propose an analytic framework for dynamic FC in resting-state EEG; it is topically related but does not clearly describe this specific dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 128-channel Amps 300 amplifier (Electrical Geodesics Inc.) at 1000 Hz during rest. Structural MRI was acquired on a GE MR750 scanner using the BRAVO sequence (FOV 240 mm, 180 axial slices per slab). Preprocessing in EEGLAB included a 0.5-100 Hz band-pass filter, a 58-62 Hz notch filter, removal of noisy channels and artifacts, interpolation of bad channels, average re-referencing, and downsampling to 250 Hz.
